info.name: Contact Endpoints API
info.description:
The Contact API allows you to manage contacts associated with your VoPay account.

Contact Support:
 Name: API Support
 Email: help@vopay.com

Plaid Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated user bank account details from Plaid.
Mx Processor Token. VoPay will fetch the associated user bank account details from Mx.
